topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I can’t believe they moved you to another department, it feels like a punch in the gut. We’ve been side by side through every project, every late night, and now this? I get it, the company has its reasons, but I can't shake this overwhelming sense that something’s lost. The office just won’t be the same, and I don’t know how I’ll fill the hours without ducking into your cubicle to bounce ideas off you or just to laugh about the latest meeting mishap. I’m going to fight for more cross-department projects, find a way to keep our collaboration going. We can’t let this distance get in the way, okay? We’re a team, no matter what they say or do.
